title: The Large Reciprocating Coolant Pump
author: Professional-Toe5265
selftext:
Some cinematic shots of rough early builds of the demo for my game SOLUS. 

The pump pushes liquid through the facility’s systems under pressure, using a spinning crank to drive a piston back and forth. Its cooling fins release excess heat, while the gauges and screens let workers monitor its temperature, pressure, and operating status.

The game is inspired by my favorite childhood games like Doom 3 and Stalker. I always wished I could experience Mars City as an open world seamless evolving experience I could live in. I am still obsessed with Mars City to this today and eventually want to get even more detail and world atmosphere like fog or smoke or steam and etc. 

Next up is more heavy machinery like matter converters. I also got stuff like gorey growth and flesh tunnels in the works once the full demo is ready I plan to have multiple regions to visit via a monorail that can travel underground. I also plan to make this underground tunnel system walkable incase power is offline. 

My current workflow is using Blender and Godot MCP with 6.1 Sol Ultra for specific things and High for most tasks. 

It does the code and models while I do the game documentation like lore and etc 

I so far also have a PDA system which is a tablet that is handheld 

Ultimately when the game is done I want an evolving and replayable survival horror sci fi fps against the forces of Hell aboard a massive mars research city. I want some kind of hideout mechanic and once I can finish writing the lore and flushing it out I want constantly evolving lore. Perhaps via pda updates through an llm? Not sure yet though. Excited though. I have been having a blast working on the game I’ve wanted since I was a kid. I always wanted a more grounded and realistic and open Doom 3 so I’m using that in my design philosophy. No monster closets or etc lol I want things to be realistic too. 

Anyway I’m done rambling haha! This is SOLUS!
